Ravi Kapoor: hi - first week q: where do ppl store "live" notes vs official docs? also need edit access to the "team onboarding checklist" template, who to ping?
Tori Nguyen: welcome! Live/personal notes -> My Workspace. Official -> Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Product. If you want teammates to see your notes, move them to Team > New Hires.
Ravi Kapoor: cool. for edit access is it ok to just duplicate and edit, or should I request permission on the source?
Samir Bose: duplicate for personal edits. If you need to change the canonical template, request edit on the source so we can track changes. Use this quick Slack snippet to create the ticket:
```
@DocsBot request-edit https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Templates/Onboarding-Checklist --reason "tailor for product ramp"
```
DocsBot: Ticket DOC-8239 created for Ravi Kapoor -> Onboarding-Checklist. Assigned to Docs (Product). ETA 1 business day.
Ravi Kapoor: thanks! one last thing: any recommended 1:1 and goals template names?
Tori Nguyen: Templates > New Hire Toolkit -> 1:1 Agenda, 30-60-90 Goals. Duplicate and prefix with your name so managers can find them. :thumbsup:
